name: cc-agy-plugin
description: Delegate coding, review, and research tasks from Claude Code to Gemini models (gemini-flash-next and gemini-4-argon) via your Gemini Enterprise subscription (`agy` CLI), Google AI Studio, or Vertex AI (`google-antigravity` + `google-genai`).

auth_mode.title: Authentication Mode
auth_mode.description: Connection mode: 'auto' (default: uses API key / Vertex project when set, otherwise signed-in Antigravity CLI), 'gemini_enterprise' (use your Gemini Enterprise seat quota via standalone `agy` CLI Google sign-in), 'api_key', 'vertex', or 'gateway'.

agy_cli_path.title: Antigravity CLI Binary Path
agy_cli_path.description: Optional path to an external Antigravity CLI (`agy`) binary for Gemini Enterprise mode. Leave unset to use ~/.local/share/cc-agy-plugin/bin/agy or `agy` on PATH.

gemini_api_key.title: Google AI Studio API Key
gemini_api_key.description: Optional Gemini API Key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). Takes precedence over GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT in the environment unless an explicit project argument is passed.

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud Project ID
google_cloud_project.description: GCP project ID with Vertex AI API enabled for Gemini billing and quota (used when no Gemini API key is active or when project is explicitly passed).

google_cloud_location.title: Default Vertex AI Region
google_cloud_location.description: Default Vertex AI region (for example us-central1 or global). Models that only exist in global are routed automatically.

cost_profile.title: Cost and Quality Profile
cost_profile.description: Routing preset: 'economy' (gemini-flash-next only, no automatic model escalation), 'balanced' (default: gemini-flash-next with automatic retry escalation to gemini-4-argon), or 'quality' (gemini-4-argon by default).

default_delegate_model.title: Default Agentic Worker Model Override
default_delegate_model.description: Optional Gemini model ID override for Antigravity SDK delegations (for example gemini-flash-next or gemini-4-argon). Leave unset to use the active cost_profile default.

default_ask_model.title: Default Single-Shot Review Model Override
default_ask_model.description: Optional Gemini model ID override for single-shot google-genai queries (for example gemini-flash-next or gemini-4-argon). Leave unset to use the active cost_profile default.

strict_delegation_mode.title: Strict Orchestrator Mode
strict_delegation_mode.description: When enabled, PreToolUse and Stop hooks block direct host file edits and require all diffs to trace back to verified worker receipts.

vertex_base_url.title: Custom AI Gateway URL
vertex_base_url.description: Optional corporate or AI gateway base URL for Gemini calls (for example Bifrost or an internal proxy). Leave unset for direct Google endpoints.

vertex_base_url_token.title: Custom AI Gateway Virtual Key / Token
vertex_base_url_token.description: Optional bearer token or virtual key sent to vertex_base_url when using an AI gateway.

max_daily_cents.title: Daily Spend Cap (Cents)
max_daily_cents.description: Optional daily workspace spend limit in US cents (for example 500 for $5.00/day). Leave unset or 0 for no daily cap.

allowed_projects.title: Allowed GCP Projects
allowed_projects.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of Google Cloud project IDs permitted for Vertex AI or Gemini Enterprise (`agy` CLI). Any other project is rejected at 0 tokens.

blocked_projects.title: Blocked GCP Projects
blocked_projects.description: Optional comma-separated blocklist of Google Cloud project IDs that must never be billed or used (checked across Vertex AI, ADC quota_project_id, and `agy` CLI onboarding).

auto_apply_on_pass.title: Auto-Apply Verified Worker Diffs
auto_apply_on_pass.description: Set to false to require manual diff review (`get_diff` then `delegate_apply`) on every worker job and disable automatic shutdown salvage.
